        SUM(l_quantity) AS supplier_total
    FROM lineitem li
    JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    WHERE o.o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT'
      AND li.l_shipmode = 'MAIL'
    GROUP BY l_suppkey
),
supplier_buckets AS (

        CASE 
            WHEN supplier_total <= 1000 THEN '0-1000'

            ELSE '5000+'
        END AS volume_bucket
    FROM supplier_totals
)

FROM supplier_buckets

results.response:

   - '1000-5000' for totals > 1000 and <= 5000

SELECT
    c.c_mktsegment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' THEN o.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) AS high_priority_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority != '2-HIGH' THEN o.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) AS other_priority_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment
